mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the past two months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI increases do not correlate with subsequent Fed rate hikes.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in one month signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the drop in UNRATE does not correlate with increased consumer spending.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over the past three months indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of periods following RSAFS increases, or RSAFS growth does not correlate with earnings growth.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the past two months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as companies face reduced output and profitability.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO declines do not correlate with reduced corporate earnings.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is above 250, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL does not correlate with negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points in the same month, it signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction of PAYEMS and UNRATE does not correlate with increased consumer confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over the past two months signals a surge in demand for housing, which boosts related sectors and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increases do not correlate with positive returns in related sectors.

mechanism_narrative: When Industrial Production (INDPRO) is below its 12-month moving average and GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative, it signals a supply-side recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of INDPRO and GDPC1 does not correlate with negative returns during recessions.
